acquisition method: The Q Exactive Plus was operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 55mM iodoacetamide for 45 min at room temperature (RT)
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 55mM iodoacetamide for 45 min at room temperature (RT)
cleavage agent: Proteins were subsequently digested with trypsin (Promega, sequencing-grade) at an enzyme to substrate ratio of 1:50 overnight at RT.
collision energy: fragmented (collision energy (nCE): 33%) by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
enrichment method: phospohotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC)
Phosphotyrosine enrichment of labeled samples was performed using a phospohotyrosine immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC).
fragmentation method: fragmented (collision energy (nCE): 33%) by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: Thermo Fisher Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
Peptides were analyzed using a Thermo Fisher Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: Lyophilized peptides were labeled using tandem mas tag (TMT) 10-plex (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
mass analyzer: Full-scan mass spectra (resolution 70k) were detected in the Orbitrap analyzer
precursor tolerance: Spectra were matched using an initial mass tolerance of 10 ppm on precursor masses
ptm: fixed: cysteine carbamidomethylation; fixed: TMT-labeled lysine; fixed: TMT-labeled protein N-terminals; variable: oxidized methionine; variable: serine, threonine, and tyrosine phosphorylation

with fixed modifications of cysteine carbamidomethylation, TMT-labeled lysine and TMT-labeled protein N-terminals. Variable modifications were oxidized methionine and serine, threonine, and tyrosine phosphorylation.
reduction reagent: reduced with 10mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at 56°C
reduction concentration: reduced with 10mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at 56°C
